items.question: Format of a git-tracked register of decisions (open/ruled status per decision)
items.rationale: Per-line diffs and clean merges; parses natively in PowerShell 5.1. SQLite cannot be diffed; Issues leave the repo; YAML needs a module in the gate.

items.question: Key scheme for decisions when 291 bare IDs (e.g. D-2 in 27 docs) collide across docs

options.label: (b)
options.text: renumber every decision to a global ID, rewriting 210 docs

items.rationale: (c) merges unrelated decisions. (b) rewrites 210 docs and breaks every existing citation in commits and memories. (a) changes no doc.

items.question: Where the ruling text lives

options.label: (a)
options.text: in the doc's decision table and in the register, kept consistent by a gate check

options.label: (b)
options.text: register only; doc rows point to it

items.rationale: The doc stays self-describing if the register is lost; the gate check turns drift into a push failure.

items.question: Backfill scope for the decision register

options.label: (a)
options.text: ratchet: seed only decisions open today; add a ruled row when its own doc is next touched

options.label: (b)
options.text: full backfill of every decision row in 210 docs

options.label: (c)
options.text: living docs: (a) plus every ruled decision in docs linked from the queue, roadmap or handovers of the last 30 days

items.rationale: The recorded stale claims were written in OTHER docs (the queue) about decisions ruled elsewhere, so (a)'s touch-the-doc ratchet never adds those rows and the stale-claim check cannot fire. (c) covers what seats actually cite. (b) records more but costs several sessions.

items.question: Severity of a gate check that flags an added line calling a ruled decision 'owed/queued'

options.label: (a)
options.text: FAIL on push, added lines only

items.rationale: (a), but only after measuring false positives on 30 days of commits and exempting correction lines that also carry a ruling marker. (c) fails on day one across 555 legacy files; (b) is an alarm that gets ignored.

items.question: Role of the trader tick queue doc once a register and a generated state view exist

options.label: (a)
options.text: order and gates only; state moves out; old banner blocks archived

options.label: (b)
options.text: leave it; add the generated view beside it

items.rationale: (b) keeps two homes for the same state, which is the cause of the staleness.

items.question: Timing of the register build with a 6-week holiday starting 2026-10-14 and a build freeze during it
items.rationale: The holiday rule bars builds; a half-built gate over 6 unattended weeks helps no one; the pre-holiday list is full.

items.question: Two parked AI-judgment sweeps (shipped-state sweep, cross-doc contradiction sweep) that overlap a new deterministic gate

options.label: (a)
options.text: keep parked; build the deterministic layer first; re-scope after it

items.rationale: The register gives the ground truth both sweeps lack; after it lands, what remains for them is pure prose judgment.
